narrative.intro: Brookhaven Science Associates obligated $830M in federal contract funding in FY2026 to date. Brookhaven Science Associates received 2 awards this period, with an average award size of $415M and obligations down 0.5% year over year. The Department of Energy obligated $830M, making the Department of Energy the dominant buyer for Brookhaven Science Associates in FY2026 to date. Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Biotechnology) accounted for $830M of obligations, and a secondary NAICS category accounted for $16K. Fiscal-year obligations show a sequence of annual totals: FY21 $668M, FY22 $951M, FY23 $789M, FY24 $797M, FY25 $834M, and FY26 $830M. The page lists a small additional obligation from the National Aeronautics and Space Administration at $16K. These figures are partial, reflecting fiscal year to date totals and award-value distinctions for certain tables where noted.
